demand: Add native Gotify support as an additional alert/notification provider where ntfy and other channels already exist.

E_independent_demand.reason: The issue is an independently filed user-facing feature request for Gotify support.

A_capability_absent.reason: Exact pre-demand source contains email/slack/discord/telegram/ntfy channel types and no Gotify implementation or channel type.

T_low_treatment_contamination.reason: The issue requests native Gotify support and notes similarity to ntfy/REST, but does not prescribe an internal interface, registry, class hierarchy, or exact source-level treatment.

P_pair_realizable.reason: Source topology admits both a bounded dedicated Gotify extension and a typed channel-adapter/registry alternative without changing the requested user-facing capability.

O_common_oracle.reason: Both treatments can be judged with the same deterministic mocked HTTP oracle over endpoint, auth, payload, severity mapping, error handling and test-channel behavior.
